summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for government activities that are not the everyday running costs.
It would provide roughly seven-twelfths of the estimated 2025-26 funding for those activities, plus new budget measures and extra spending already agreed for the rest of 2024-25.
Under the Constitution, ordinary annual services must be in a separate bill; a companion supply bill covers the remaining five-twelfths to ensure enough money for the first five months of 2025-26.
changes: Draws money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for non-ordinary services.
Sets the initial funding at about seven-twelfths of the estimated annual amount for 2025-26, plus budget measures and outstanding 2024-25 items.
Works alongside a supply bill that provides the other five-twelfths for the start of the financial year.
summary.affected: Federal government departments and agencies that deliver services not classified as ordinary annual services.
